result.reason: The edit appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes at-will revocability while retaining the Services limitation and existing use restrictions. However, it permits termination whenever the Agreement or applicable attachment expires or terminates, rather than limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, and it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or permit transfer to an M&A successor. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions.
